_meta.purpose: Demo-only pincode to coordinate table. The app never calls an external geocoder; a pincode that is not in this file is rejected.
_meta.coordinate_basis: APPROXIMATE AREA CENTRES typed in by hand for the demo (roughly the main post-office / city-centre area). They are not surveyed points and not taken from an India Post dataset, so expect errors of a few km. Straight-line distance only.
_meta.extra_entries_note: 400001 (Mumbai) and 132103 (Panipat) are not in the original city list; they were added only because seeded demo processors sit in those cities.
